import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Container, Row, Col, Card, Form, Button, Alert, InputGroup, Badge } from "react-bootstrap"; import Navbar from "./Navbar"; import Sidebar from "./Sidebar"; import { deposit } from "../api/bankingApi"; import { getAccountId } from "../utils/auth"; import { useHistory } from "react-router-dom"; /* ── Dummy static QR code (SVG data URI) ─────────────────────────────── This is a placeholder QR-style graphic for demo purposes only. It does not encode real payment data. ──────────────────────────────── */ const DUMMY_QR_SVG = "data:image/svg+xml;base64," + btoa(` `); function QrPayment() { const history = useHistory(); const [amount, setAmount] = useState(""); const [step, setStep] = useState("scan"); // "scan" | "confirm" | "success" const [message, setMessage] = useState(""); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); /* ── Step 1: "Scan" the dummy QR → move to confirm step ──────────────── */ const handleScan = () => { if (!amount || parseFloat(amount) <= 0) { setMessage("Please enter a valid amount before scanning."); return; } setMessage(""); setStep("confirm"); }; /* ── Step 2: Confirm → call the existing deposit API ────────────────── NOTE: this reuses the same /banking deposit endpoint as the Deposit page, since this is a dummy QR flow simulating a deposit into the user's own account rather than a real merchant payment rail. ──────── */ const handleConfirm = async () => { setLoading(true); try { await deposit({ accountId: parseInt(getAccountId(), 10), amount: parseFloat(amount) }); setStep("success"); localStorage.setItem("refreshDashboard", "true"); } catch (error) { console.error("QR payment error:", error); setMessage("Payment failed. Please try again."); setStep("scan"); } setLoading(false); }; const reset = () => { setAmount(""); setMessage(""); setStep("scan"); }; return (
{message && ( {message} )} QR Payment Demo Mode {/* ── STEP 1: Scan ───────────────────────────────────── */} {step === "scan" && ( <>

Scan this QR code with any NexaBank-supported app to deposit funds instantly.

Amount to Deposit ₹ setAmount(e.target.value)} />
)} {/* ── STEP 2: Confirm ────────────────────────────────── */} {step === "confirm" && ( <>
Confirm Payment

Review the details below before confirming this deposit.

Payment Method Dummy QR Code
Account #{getAccountId()}
Amount ₹{parseFloat(amount).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
)} {/* ── STEP 3: Success ────────────────────────────────── */} {step === "success" && ( <>
Payment Successful

₹{parseFloat(amount).toLocaleString("en-IN")} has been deposited to your account.

)}

This is a simulated QR payment for demo purposes. No real merchant network is involved.

); } export default QrPayment;
